extName.description: The extension's name in the browser's list.

extDescription.message: Save a 3D model page from Printables, MakerWorld, Thingiverse and more into your Khayt library, with its link.
extDescription.description: Store and extensions-page description. Under 112 characters for Safari.

popupUnsupported.message: Open a model's page on a site such as Printables or MakerWorld, then press the button again.
popupUnsupported.description: The tab is not a page that can be saved.

popupBy.description: Creator line. $1 is the creator's name.

popupOneFile.description: One download link found on the page.

popupFiles.description: Download links found on the page. $1 is a number.

popupWhatHappens.message: It goes into your Khayt library as a model to print, with a link back to this page. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
popupWhatHappens.description: Under the preview: what Save does.

popupDone.description: The button after saving; closes the popup.

resultSaved.message: Saved. It's in your library under Saved from web, on the Print next list.

resultUpdated.message: Already in your library — brought up to date.
resultUpdated.description: The same page was saved before.

resultAttached.message: The file was added to the saved model.

resultQueued.message: Khayt isn't open. It will be added to your library when Khayt opens.
resultQueued.description: Written to the inbox; no answer from the app yet.

resultRefused.description: Refused for a reason with no sentence of its own.

resultRefusedOff.message: Saving from the browser is switched off in Khayt (Settings ▸ Preferences ▸ Browser extension).
resultRefusedOff.description: The shop turned the feature off.

resultRefusedLock.message: The person signed in to Khayt can't change the library.

resultRefusedSample.message: Khayt is showing the sample shop. Open your own book, then save again.
resultRefusedSample.description: The sample book cannot be written.

resultInvalid.message: This page couldn't be read well enough to save.

resultNoHost.message: This browser can't reach Khayt. In Khayt, open Settings ▸ Preferences ▸ Browser extension.
